correctness.rationale: For exact delivered observations the one-dimensional Dirichlet Green covariance conditions to independent Green bridges on the open gaps. The solution of (-d²/dt²+κ²)v=1 with zero gap endpoints integrates to gκ(h)=h/κ²-2tanh(κh/2)/κ³, so the four independent delivery patterns give the asserted risk, including zero-length gaps and coincident requests. Since gκ'=Hκ/κ² and gκ''>0 for h>0, the singleton-delivery terms give strict joint convexity on the ordered triangle. Reflection forces x+y=1. Along this line the derivative changes sign between separations 0 and 1/3, giving (1) and the unique optimizer. The ratio Tκ(u) of upper to lower Hκ increments increases strictly from zero to infinity in u. For wκ=Hκ', the identity ∂t log wκ=κ[csch(κt)-tanh(κt/2)] verifies the stated negative mixed derivative for t>0. Integrating the resulting decreasing weight ratio over the two ordered intervals gives strictly decreasing T at fixed u as κ increases. This proves both parameter monotonicities. At κ→0 the normalized H tends uniformly to t²/4, giving 3pu²+(4-2p)u-p=0 and the radical. For every fixed 0<u<1/3, the positive ratio Tκ(u) tends exponentially to zero; monotonicity then forces the optimizer to tend to 1/3. The stationarity equation in sech² form gives κ(a-u)=log(1/p)+o(1) for fixed p, with the b term exponentially smaller. For p=1, strict convexity of the three-gap cost gives trisection. Inspected the bounded Schur complement and design diagnostics without executing the source script; the limiting and continuum assertions follow analytically.
